narrative: Strait of Hormuz blast reports introduce a geopolitical risk premium as JPY leads G10 (+1.42% avg) on risk-premium demand; USD/JPY retreats to 157.64 while gold firms +1.20%; equities -0.17%; DXY -0.01%; VIX 15.8.
